It'll hold em' off for a bit!|[[Giga AJ]] dialogue on Wave 1 ([[Metaverse Champions Event]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Zombies are approaching, defend!|Beginning of Wave 1 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Easy Mode|Beginner's]] & [[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Normal''' is the first [[Enemies|enemy]] in the [[Easy Mode|Easy]], [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]], Basic Arena [[PVP]], Molten Arena [[PVP]] and [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] modes. It also appears in the tutorial and first chapters of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. As the first enemy that spawns, it has fairly mediocre speed and low health. The [[Grave Digger]] used to have a chance to spawn the '''Normal''' with its ''Triumphing Sheol'' ability on [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. The '''Normal''' also has a chance to be spawned by the [[Mystery]] upon its death in [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode. In [[Challenge Maps]], both the [[Mystery]] and [[Mystery Boss]] can summon it upon death. The '''Normal''' is also spawned by the [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]]. The '''Normal''' also appeared in [[The Heights]] as part of the [[SFOTH Event]], in [[Cyber City]] as part of the [[Metaverse Champions Event]], was part of the [[The Classic Event]] and part of [[The Takeover Event]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Normal''' is a humanoid with a green skin color as well as a brown torso and legs. It is faceless and lightly covered in dirt. It has three animations that are randomly chosen. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Normal''' had a green skin color, as well as a brown torso and legs. It was faceless. It had a single animation originally, though after the [[V1.20.0|Intermediate Mode Update]], it had three animations that were randomly chosen. }} |Legacy |{{Tabber |Current |The third version of the '''Normal''' had a light green skin color, as well as a brown torso and legs. There were two scars on its face, which form a cross. |Current (Enemies Beta) |The [[Enemies Beta]] version of the '''Normal''' has a green skin color, as well as a brown torso and legs. It is faceless |Version 2 |The second version of the '''Normal''' had a vibrant green skin color, as well as a lighter brown torso and legs. It had a sad face. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Normal''' had a desaturated light green skin color, and a brown torso and darker brown legs. It had a drooling zombie face. }} }} ==Strategy== *Most towers can deal with the '''Normal''' effectively. **Any tower catered towards early game, like the [[Scout]], [[Soldier]], [[Militant]], [[Assassin]] or [[Cowboy]] are recommended. **It is unnecessary to try to get stronger, more expensive towers like the [[Minigunner]] solely to deal with '''Normals''', as it is too expensive to reliably deal with Normals in the early game. **Towers that can deal damage to multiple enemies are especially effective against '''Normals''' as they spawn in hordes. Such towers include the [[Demoman]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Pyromancer]] and [[Shotgunner]]. *It is perfectly fine to avoid defending against the first few waves of '''Normals''' and simply let them reach the exit, as their low health makes it unlikely to make you lose. **You can use the [[Medic]] to heal the base health back, but this is not necessary. **As you are not spending money on defenses, you can use the [[Farm]] more effectively for the first few waves to get better towers when stronger enemies appear. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants (Modern)}}
